semanticBoundary.graphOrder: RCL declares the ordered node list, operation, inputs, dimensions and readback policy
semanticBoundary.tensorIdentity: storageIdentity plus deterministic valueRoot remains the canonical Tensor reference
semanticBoundary.intermediateResource: ephemeral ordered device resource, not canonical Tensor value
semanticBoundary.operations: generic Tensor matmul and additive masked softmax only
semanticBoundary.maskedSoftmax: BF16 storage, FP32 stable row normalization, BF16 RNE output
semanticBoundary.providerRole: auxiliary OpenCL cl_mem allocation, kernel argument binding and ordered dispatch organ only

residency.resourceLifetime: one graph request; every ephemeral output resource is released before session close
residency.inputLifetime: resident Tensor inputs remain bound for the enclosing provider session
residency.outputResource: ephemeral ordered device resource, not canonical Tensor value

acceptance: RCL validates a bounded ordered graph of two through eight generic Tensor nodes
matmul nodes require rank-2 BF16 dimensions and masked-softmax nodes require equal-shape logits/mask inputs
masked-softmax nodes require explicit additive maskMode and omit shared
each graph node consumes resident Tensor references or a resource produced by an earlier node
intermediate outputs remain device-resident and no intermediate device-to-host readback is permitted
the final node performs exactly one explicit device-to-host readback
all graph output resources and resident Tensor inputs are released before session close
operation, resource order, shape mismatch and unavailable AMD OpenCL fail closed
